title: A Large-Scale Benchmark and Risk Assessment of Traffic Analysis Attacks on Cloud LLM Services
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充
missingSignals: 材料中提供代码或数据链接（未核验内容）

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present, to our knowledge, the first unified measurement study and public benchmark of encrypted LLM traffic across both user--LLM and multi-agent executions.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Cloud-based Large language model (LLM) services create a network-level traffic side channel that can expose model, prompt, and task behavior despite encryption.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Model fingerprinting achieves 97.7\% balanced accuracy, prompt-category fingerprinting reaches 76.7\% mean accuracy, and multi-agent task fingerprinting achieves up to 90.7\% accuracy.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Yet current evidence is fragmented across separate datasets and settings, limiting reproducibility and comparison.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The large-scale benchmark contains 60,000 user--LLM interactions across 10 models and 6 prompt categories, plus 2,838 multi-agent executions covering 10 task categories and two coordination topologies.

evidence.label: 讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验
evidence.excerpt: Using only encrypted packet metadata, we assess the risk of traffic analysis attack by characterizing traffic signatures, identifying the features most associated with leakage, and testing robustness under prompt reformulation, decoding-temperature changes, larger candidate model sets, and partial traffic observation.
